h1: Do I need a permit to replace central air conditioning in Newton, MA?
title: Newton Central AC Replacement Permits: Electrical and Equipment Work
description: Learn which Newton permit offices to contact before replacing central air equipment, disconnects, or associated building systems.
short_answer: Replacing central air equipment can involve regulated equipment and electrical work. Newton ISD administers electrical permits and other permits for regulated equipment. The official sources reviewed do not establish a universal mechanical-permit rule or one outdoor-unit setback for every replacement.

facts.text: Newton ISD issues permits for regulated equipment and administers separate electrical permit applications.

qa.q: Does a like-for-like central AC replacement always need a mechanical permit?
qa.a: The sources reviewed do not establish a universal answer. Confirm the exact equipment replacement, duct changes, electrical work, and inspection requirements with Newton ISD.
